purpose: Teach: 雅子/恵子/静香/直人/健一/和夫/篤/哉

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「雅子様の御活動はご立派」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was saying earlier that Masako-sama's work is truly impressive.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone sharing something Dad said. Light, almost amused. Speaking to Sho as if letting him in on a pleasant observation. Gentle cadence.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんのお友達の恵子おばさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom — I got to meet Keiko-aunt, one of Dad's friends!
lines.style: Bright, eager energy. Clear pride at being included in an adult world. Quick, animated pace. Sits forward slightly in the voice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお仕事仲間の静香さんが家にいらしたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father's colleague Shizuka-san came by the house today.
lines.style: Thoughtful, observational tone. Not performing emotion, just noting something interesting that happened. Even pace, gentle settling quality. A moment of quiet reflection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと直人おじさんと釣りに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom — I went fishing with Dad and Uncle Naoto!
lines.style: Genuine delight with a child's unselfconscious pride. Rushes slightly with excitement. Warm, open resonance. The joy of having been included in something special.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「健一さんは篤実な方」と仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was saying that Kenichi-san is truly a sincere person.
lines.style: Warm, conversational. Sharing an impression Dad gave. Thoughtful pacing. Slight lift at the end, like she's turning it over gently in her mind while speaking.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと和夫おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom — I met Uncle Kazuo with Dad!
lines.style: Eager, bright delivery. Child's enthusiasm at the meeting. Quick tempo, genuine warmth. Voice opens up, almost bubbling with the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんは「篤志、つまり篤い志を持つ事が大事」って教えて下さるわ
lines.en: Sho — your father taught me that having a sincere heart — having true aspiration — is what matters most.
lines.style: Thoughtful, taking in the weight of what he learned. Measured pace. Slight care in the phrasing, as if he's holding onto the lesson carefully. Respectful, earnest attention.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに「快哉、つまり「快哉!」と叫ぶ場面もある」って教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad taught me that "kaisai" — that moment when you cry out with joy and triumph — that's real too!
lines.style: Warm, earnest delivery with underlying delight. Carefully enunciating the concept. Building toward genuine passion on the final thought. Sincere and close, as if confiding something he values.
